nodes.name: Schedule Trigger
nodes.notes: Fires every Monday 8am. Change cadence here for testing (e.g. seconds interval) without touching anything downstream.

nodes.name: Fetch HubSpot Deals
nodes.notes: Create a private app token in HubSpot (Settings > Integrations > Private Apps) with crm.objects.deals.read scope. Store it as an n8n Header Auth credential: name 'Authorization', value 'Bearer <token>'. Pagination config walks paging.next.after until HubSpot stops returning it - this is the manual-pagination skill, don't swap in the built-in HubSpot node for this project.

nodes.name: Aggregate Deals by Week
nodes.notes: Handles the fact the HTTP node returns one item per page. Groups by ISO week so it lines up with the GA4 branch.

nodes.name: Fetch GA4 Sessions
nodes.notes: Needs a Google Cloud OAuth2 client with the Google Analytics Data API enabled, and the n8n user added as a viewer on the GA4 property. Swap the property ID before running.

nodes.name: Merge by Week
nodes.notes: Input 1 = Aggregate Deals by Week, Input 2 = Aggregate GA4 by Week. Joins on the 'week' key both branches emit.

nodes.name: Format Row and Summary
nodes.notes: Produces one item per week for the Sheets rows, and stashes the human-readable summary on the first item for the email node to read.

nodes.name: Write to Google Sheets
nodes.notes: appendOrUpdate matching on 'week' means reruns for the same week overwrite instead of duplicating rows - covers the 'no dupes on rerun' item in the testing checklist.

nodes.name: Send Email Summary

parameters.subject: =Weekly automation report - {{ $json.week }}
parameters.message: ={{ $json.summaryText || 'Report generated - see attached sheet for full breakdown.' }}

nodes.notes: Only the first item carries summaryText (see Format Row and Summary node), so this only needs to run once - add a Limit node set to 1 item before this if you see duplicate emails.
